# Alarm panel (`alarm-panel`)

Arm modes, a keypad with masked code entry, arming and entry countdowns, and a triggered state.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createAlarmPanel` (types in `dist/web/home/security/alarmPanel.d.ts`): `.mh-alarm-panel`: a `__status` row (`__icon`, `__text` with the polite `__state` and `__detail`, and a`role="timer"` `__time` during the exit and entry delays), a `__bar` showing the delay left, the masked `__code`box (`__slot` dots, `.is-filled`; never the digits), an `__message` (`role="alert"`), the `__keypad` of large`__key`s and `__actions` (`__modes` group of arm buttons, or the disarm button). Digits, Backspace, Escape andEnter work from a keyboard too. The code lives only in memory: it is never logged, put in an attribute orshown, and it is cleared as soon as it has been handed to `onArm` or `onDisarm`. Modifiers `--<state>`(`--unknown` when null); states `.is-busy`, `.is-error`, `.is-disabled`.

```ts
export function createAlarmPanel(options: AlarmPanelOptions): AlarmPanelHandle;

export interface AlarmPanelOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the panel (default "Alarm"). */
  label?: string;
  state?: AlarmState | null;
  /** The mode it is armed in or arming to (an id from `modes`). */
  mode?: string | null;
  /** The modes offered while disarmed (default home, away, night). */
  modes?: readonly AlarmMode[];
  /** When the exit or entry delay ends, in epoch milliseconds; shows a countdown. */
  deadline?: number | null;
  /** The whole delay in seconds, for the countdown bar. */
  delay?: number | null;
  /** Arming needs the code (default false). */
  codeToArm?: boolean;
  /** Disarming needs the code (default true). */
  codeToDisarm?: boolean;
  /** The code has this many digits: the box shows that many slots. */
  codeLength?: number | null;
  /** Longest code the keypad takes (default 12, or `codeLength`). */
  maxCodeLength?: number;
  /** A message such as "Wrong code"; a new message empties the code. */
  error?: string | null;
  disabled?: boolean;
  labels?: AlarmPanelLabelsInput;
  /** Arm in a mode, with the code when one was entered. The code is cleared from the panel straight after. */
  onArm?: (mode: string, code: string | undefined) => void;
  /** Disarm (or cancel arming), with the code when one was entered. The code is cleared straight after. */
  onDisarm?: (code: string | undefined) => void;
}

export interface AlarmPanelHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Applies changed options; omitted ones keep their value. A new state or error empties the code. */
  update(changes: Partial<AlarmPanelOptions>): void;
  /** Empties the code. */
  clearCode(): void;
  /** Stops the countdown timer. */
  destroy(): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createAlarmPanel } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const EXIT_DELAY = 30;
let exit: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

const panel = createAlarmPanel({
  label: 'House alarm',
  state: 'disarmed',
  onArm: (mode) => {
    panel.update({ state: 'arming', mode, deadline: Date.now() + EXIT_DELAY * 1000, delay: EXIT_DELAY });
    exit = setTimeout(() => panel.update({ state: 'armed', deadline: null, delay: null }), EXIT_DELAY * 1000);
  },
  // The app checks the code; the panel only hands it over and clears it.
  onDisarm: (code) => {
    if (code !== '1234') {
      panel.update({ error: 'Wrong code' });
      return;
    }
    clearTimeout(exit);
    panel.update({ state: 'disarmed', deadline: null, delay: null, error: null });
  },
});

document.body.append(panel.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { AlarmPanel } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { AlarmState } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const EXIT_DELAY = 30;

export function AlarmPanelExample() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<AlarmState>('disarmed');
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deadline, setDeadline] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (state !== 'arming') return;
    const exit = setTimeout(() => setState('armed'), EXIT_DELAY * 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(exit);
  }, [state]);
  const arm = (next: string) => {
    setMode(next);
    setDeadline(Date.now() + EXIT_DELAY * 1000);
    setState('arming');
  };
  // The app checks the code; the panel only hands it over and clears it.
  const disarm = (code: string | undefined) => {
    if (code !== '1234') {
      setError('Wrong code');
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setState('disarmed');
  };
  return (
    <AlarmPanel
      label="House alarm"
      state={state}
      mode={mode}
      deadline={state === 'arming' ? deadline : null}
      delay={EXIT_DELAY}
      error={error}
      onArm={arm}
      onDisarm={disarm}
    />
  );
}
```
